outline: This course is to analyze the macroeconomic policy, international economy, business cycles, government policy, exchange rate and other macroeconomic-related issues. The course will be taught with case studies and journal literature. Group discussions are needed.

二 The data of macroeconomics
三 National income
四 Money and inflation
五 The open economy
六 Unemployment
七 Economic growth I
八 Economic growth II
九 Midterm exam
十 Economic fluctuations
十一 Aggregate demand
十二 Aggregate supply
十三 IS-LM model I
十四 IS-LM model II
十五 IS-LM model III
十六 Macroeconomic policy
十七 Group presentation: group 1-6 (20-30 mins per group)
十八 Group presentation: group 7-12 (20-30 mins per group)
